title: lucille.exec/1 files.search document
description: What files.search returns, JSON-encoded in the stdout of its reply: the matches ripgrep found, each with its path relative to the folder, its line number and its line, as ripgrep's --json gives them. The reply's stdout_truncated is the document's truncated; an empty stdout, with the flag true, is a request cap too small for any document.

matches.description: In the order ripgrep wrote them: by path, then by line. Empty when error is not null.

truncated.description: True when not every match ripgrep wrote, or would have written, is here: past 1000 matches, past the stream's cap, a path over 4096 bytes, output the host did not keep or a search that did not end on its own, a private-key block that did not end, or error not null.

error.description: null, or unreadable_output: ripgrep wrote a line the host does not read as one of its messages, and nothing of its output is here.

path.description: The file's path relative to the folder searched, never absolute and with no .. part.

lines.description: The matching line, with the line ending it had, cut at 1000 bytes.

line_truncated.description: True when the line was longer than 1000 bytes and is cut.

path_text.description: A path that is valid UTF-8 and holds no U+0000: at most 4096 bytes of UTF-8.

path_bytes.description: A path that is not valid UTF-8: its bytes, at most 4096, in standard base64 with padding.

line_text.description: A line that is valid UTF-8 and holds no U+0000: at most 1000 bytes of UTF-8.

line_bytes.description: A line that is not valid UTF-8, or holds NUL: its bytes, at most 1000, in standard base64 with padding.
